segments.en: Warren Buffett, the most famous investor on the planet, spent the past 20 years trying to give his fortune away to charity.
segments.zh: 沃伦·巴菲特，全球最著名的市场参与者，过去20年一直试图将财富捐给慈善事业。

segments.en: But despite his best efforts and after billions of dollars in gifts every year, his net worth over the same period has more than tripled.
segments.zh: 但尽管他竭尽全力，每年捐出数十亿美元，他的净资产同期却增长了两倍多。

segments.en: Currently, 150 billion is still slated for donations.
segments.zh: 目前，仍有1500亿美元计划用于捐赠。

segments.en: Until recently, his longtime friend Bill Gates was taking care of most of that work through his own giant foundation.
segments.zh: 直到最近，他的老朋友比尔·盖茨通过自己的大型基金会处理了大部分工作。

segments.en: But after Gates faced more scrutiny over his ties to Jeffrey Epstein, Buffett said in July that he wasn't planning to make gifts to his friend's foundation anymore.
segments.zh: 但在盖茨因与杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的关系面临更多审查后，巴菲特在7月表示，他不再计划向朋友的基金会捐款。

segments.en: Instead, his whole fortune would go to four family foundations, one named for his late wife, and three run by each of his children.
segments.zh: 相反，他的全部财富将捐给四个家族基金会：一个以他已故妻子命名，另外三个由他的每个孩子运营。

segments.en: Susie, Howard, and Peter, age 73, 71, and 68 years old, the siblings have been spending what would be their retirement years,
segments.zh: 苏西、霍华德和彼得，年龄分别为73岁、71岁和68岁，这三兄妹一直在用本该退休的岁月，

segments.en: trying to find ways to give away the growing family fortune.
segments.zh: 设法捐出不断增长的家族财富。

segments.en: Together, they've spent billions of dollars on the things they care about most, international conflict mitigation, food security,
segments.zh: 他们共同将数十亿美元投入最关心的事业：缓解国际冲突、粮食安全、

segments.en: early childhood education, girls and women's rights, and more.
segments.zh: 幼儿教育、女童和妇女权利等。

segments.en: But giving away 150 billion dollars isn't a simple task, as their father's ever-growing part of money has demonstrated
segments.zh: 但捐出1500亿美元并非易事，他们父亲不断增长的财富部分已经证明了这一点。

segments.en: they'll have to dramatically pick up the pace of their giving if they want to get rid of it all before they die.
segments.zh: 如果要在去世前全部捐出，他们必须大幅加快捐赠步伐。
